name: MusicHaptics
tagline: 让支持的歌曲化作触感，随音乐感受节奏与人声。
description: MusicHaptics 为越狱 iPhone 带来音乐触感反馈，在播放支持的歌曲时，让振动跟随音乐的节奏与变化。
可选择全部混音或仅人声，搭配弱、中、强三档强度；通过设置或控制中心随时开启与关闭。
notice: iOS 18 及以上尚未完成兼容验证，不保证可用。当前不支持已测试的环境音乐免费内容及 Shazam 免费试听。首次加载歌曲触感需要联网，部分歌曲可能没有触感或人声轨道。请使用正常播放速度，并关闭杜比全景声；如已开启系统自带音乐触感，请先关闭以免重复反馈。
features: 为支持的歌曲提供同步音乐触感反馈
全部混音与仅人声两种模式
控制中心快捷开关，与设置状态同步
提供触感样本、播放状态和歌曲重试入口
支持 English、简体中文、繁體中文，并提供 Discord 与 QQ 反馈入口
compatibility: 最低 iOS 15，无最高版本限制
iOS 15 已完成 Apple Music 下载与播放实测
iOS 17 有此前版本的 Apple Music 成功记录
iOS 16 待测；iOS 18 及以上尚未完成兼容验证，不保证可用
需要支持触感反馈的越狱 iPhone
每个安装包均包含 arm64 / arm64e
usage: 安装适合越狱环境的版本并重新载入 SpringBoard，然后打开“设置 → 音乐触感”。
启用插件，选择全部混音或仅人声，并设置触感强度。
在 Apple Music 中以正常速度播放支持的歌曲；首次加载请保持网络连接。
在控制中心添加“音乐触感”，即可快速开关。
可点击“播放样本”体验当前强度；没有反馈时查看“播放状态”或重试当前歌曲。

changes: 修复 iOS 15 切换控制中心开关或调整触感强度时意外重新载入桌面的问题。
修复 iOS 15 歌曲触感下载，并改善 Apple Music 账号地区与系统地区不同时的歌曲匹配。
iOS 15 已完成 Apple Music 下载与播放实测，iOS 17 有此前版本的成功记录；iOS 16 待测，iOS 18 及以上尚未完成兼容验证。
首次发布音乐触感反馈，支持全部混音与仅人声模式。
提供弱、中、强三档强度及控制中心快捷开关。
提供三语言设置、触感样本及 Discord、QQ 反馈入口。

en.name: MusicHaptics
en.tagline: Feel the rhythm and vocals of supported songs through haptic feedback.
description: MusicHaptics brings music haptic feedback to jailbroken iPhones, with vibrations that follow the rhythm and changes of supported songs.
Choose Full Mix or Vocals Only with Weak, Medium, or Strong intensity, and toggle playback from Settings or Control Center.
en.notice: iOS 18 and later compatibility remains unverified and is not guaranteed. The tested free Ambient Music content and Shazam previews are not currently supported. An internet connection is needed to load a song's haptics for the first time. Some songs have no haptic or vocal track. Use normal playback speed with Dolby Atmos off. Turn off Apple's built-in Music Haptics before using this tweak to avoid duplicate feedback.
features: Synchronized music haptic feedback for supported songs
Full Mix and Vocals Only modes
Weak, Medium, and Strong intensity levels
Control Center toggle synchronized with Settings
Haptic sample, playback status, and song retry controls
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese, with Discord and QQ feedback links
compatibility: Requires iOS 15 or later; no upper version limit
Apple Music download and playback tested on iOS 15
Earlier Apple Music playback success on iOS 17
iOS 16 awaits testing; iOS 18 and later compatibility remains unverified and is not guaranteed
Requires a jailbroken iPhone with haptic support
usage: Install the version matching your jailbreak environment, respring, then open Settings → Music Haptics.
Enable the tweak, select Full Mix or Vocals Only, and choose an intensity level.
Play a supported song in Apple Music at normal speed; keep an internet connection for the first load.
Add Music Haptics to Control Center for quick toggling.
Use Play Sample to feel the selected intensity. If a song produces no feedback, check Playback Status or retry it.

changes: Fix unexpected resprings when toggling Control Center or changing haptic intensity on iOS 15.
Fix song haptic downloads on iOS 15 and improve matching when the Apple Music account region differs from the device region.
Apple Music download and playback were tested on iOS 15, with earlier success on iOS 17; iOS 16 awaits testing, and iOS 18 or later compatibility remains unverified.
First release of music haptic feedback with Full Mix and Vocals Only modes.
Includes Weak, Medium, and Strong intensity levels and a Control Center toggle.
Includes trilingual settings, a haptic sample, and Discord and QQ feedback links.
